title: Source realization and completion commute with coefficient enlargement
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible on both schemes, and only a native realization R on X. At finite coefficient field E define s_E: Q_Y,E⋙inclusion_Y,E⋙commonPull(g)⋙ordinary(R) ≅ V_Y,E⋙podCompletedDerivedInverseImage(E,g)⋙nativeExtend_R,E. Its component is the source equality transport, R.integral(E), then native extension of the inverse actual completed-to-tower comparison. For E≤L and integral constructible K on Y, identify the literal enlarged rational stage with Q_Y,L of integralTransition(K), and call the resulting common-stage arrow t_K. Then A(t_K)≫s_L(K_L) = s_E(K)≫a_X(G_E K)^−1≫nativeExtend_R,L(b_K)≫nativeExtend_R,L(G_L(χ_Y,K)), where A=commonPull(g)⋙ordinary(R), a_X is the native derived scalar associator, b is completedScalarReindex from [def-sf-adic-reindex-scalar-maps], and χ_Y is the actual finite-free completion map. This square contains neither a realization on Y nor a RingReindex or IntegralReindex datum.

proof.text: The chosen stage transition equals rational scalar extension by its existence specification. rationalScalar_obj identifies its value on a localized integral object with localization of the integral transition. Postcompose isoToStage with this equality transport to obtain the literal arrow t_K. Form s_E from the six source factors of the integral realization composite.

R.common_field replaces the other transition by R.integral(E), inverse native scalar associator, completedScalarComparison, and R.integral(L)^−1. Move the native scalar associator across the E comparison using naturality.

proof.text: The actual podCompletedToTower comparison is inverse image of the actual completion unit followed by the specified inverse limit and pullback-model identifications. Whole-cone normalization identifies it with the normalized inverse-image comparison, including its zero shifted coordinate. Apply isomorphismComparison_scalarExtension to these very maps. The complete constructible comparison components are invertible, so invert their square, conjugate by the scalar model of [def-sf-adic-reindex-scalar-maps], and apply native scalar extension. This is exactly the remaining square after the expansions; functoriality composes the endpoint equality transports.

lean.statement:
theorem realizationReindexSource_scalar (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    (E L : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) (h : E ≤ L)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y) :
    let i := coefficientInclusion l (PadicAlgCl l) E L h
    let C := Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l)
    let aX := pbcReductionNormalization (completedCoefficientMap l (C E) (C L) i X)
      (coefficientMap l X R L) (coefficientMap l X R E) (R.coefficient_scalar E L h)
    (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g ⋙ ordinary l X R).map
        (realizationScalarArrow l Y E L h K) ≫
      (realizationReindexSource l g R L).hom.app
        ((integralTransition l (PadicAlgCl l) Y E L h).obj K) =
    (realizationReindexSource l g R E).hom.app K ≫
      (aX ((podCompletedDerivedInverseImage l (C E) g).obj K.obj)).inv ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R L)).map
        ((completedScalarReindex l (C E) (C L) i g).hom.app K.obj) ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R L)).map
        ((podCompletedDerivedInverseImage l (C L) g).map
          ((completedScalarComparison l (C E) (C L) i Y).app K.obj))
